text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I was passed, couldn't get back ahead,
and pulled further behind... ngh.
choice_data_list: For now, let's feel as frustrated as we want!
Next, it's City's turn to pull away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so mad, seriously unreal!
My head's just spinning from how that final stretch went...!"
choice_data_list: Still, you've got a great look on your face, City.
Still, you've got a great look on your face, City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
What, are you making fun of me—
choice_data_list: That's the face of a girl burning with the desire to win.
That's the look of someone burning to win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am!
I'm definitely not gonna lose anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...! I don't want to let
anyone catch up to me either!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to blow past everyone and win. I won't let anything get in the way of my desire to run...!
choice_data_list: Then let's become the kind of runner who can win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking.
Does that mean you're that confident?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm leaving half of it in your hands.
—Make me someone who can win!
